name: @ship/sui-media
description: Ship Media pack — the PURE leaf content renderers (sui-media-image raster+SVG, sui-media-csv→sui-table, sui-media-av audio/video) plus the pure detection/parse engine (createMimeRegistry resolution, MIME detect, CSV parse, the ViewerRenderer contract). Renderers receive already-resolved bytes/text via `prop:src` identity and never fetch. The kind→TAG dispatch table lives in the @ship/viewer router, not here — this engine resolves whatever entry list it is handed.
